newsitem.title: USA: Westmark says Medical to get note.
newsitem.headline: Westmark says Medical to get note.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said on Monday that Medical Industries of America Inc has agreed to accept a note of up to $3.7 million from it.
Westmark said the note would be amortized over ten years, with a balloon payment in three years.

The note, together with a $300,000 cash payment from Westmark, forms part of a settlement agreement between the two companies that restructures the debt and equity positions each company holds in the other, Westmark said.
Under the agreement, Medical Industries will return 1.6 million Westmark common shares and 200,000 Westmark preferred shares to Westmark. The preferred shares have a stated value of $700,000.
Westmark, for its part, will return to Medical Industries 200,000 convertible preferred shares of Medical Industries, valued at $2 million.

Mark Schaftlein, chief operating officer of Westmark, said the transaction with Medical Industries will enable Westmark to focus its efforts on its core business of buying and selling credit mortgages.
